safe_render_guards: Dashboard data is stored as nullable state and rendered through const safeState = state ?? {}.
Metrics default to users = 0, orgs = 0, approvals = 0, logs = [].
List payloads are read through safeItems and optional chaining.
Unknown strings, errors, dates, counts, organization context, and execution mode are normalized before render.
All data fetches use Promise.allSettled plus try/finally so failed endpoints cannot leave the dashboard blank or stuck.
